chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
That Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام was brought a man who had sold a free person, so he cut off his hand.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in this report
key_terms.بَاعَ: sold, referring to the unlawful act of selling a free human being
key_terms.حُرًّا: a free person, meaning someone not lawfully subject to sale or ownership
key_terms.فَقَطَعَ: so he cut off, indicating the imposed corporal punishment
key_terms.يَدَهُ: his hand, the limb mentioned in the legal penalty

ai.seo_question: What was the ruling of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام on a man who sold a free person?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام concerning a man who sold a free person. It indicates the gravity of violating human freedom and presents the ruling within the context of penal law.
